items.stem: A team wants alerts that reflect what users actually experience rather than internal machine state. Which signal is the best basis for the alert?

options.text: A service-level indicator such as request success rate or latency
options.rationale: Correct: SLIs describe user-facing behaviour, the right basis for SLO alerts.

options.text: Raw CPU utilization of one VM
options.rationale: CPU can be high or low without reflecting user impact.

options.text: The number of log lines written
options.rationale: Log volume does not map to user experience.
Deployment count is unrelated to live user experience.

items.explanation: Correct: SLIs describe user-facing behaviour, the right basis for SLO alerts.

items.stem: Which TWO practices improve cost attribution on Google Cloud? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Apply consistent labels to resources for team and environment
Export billing data for detailed analysis
options.rationale: Correct: billing export supports custom cost reporting.

options.text: Put every workload in a single project
options.rationale: One project collapses the boundaries useful for attribution.

options.text: Disable billing reports to save overhead
options.rationale: Disabling reports removes the visibility you need.

items.explanation: Correct: both keyed options are right; the distractors are wrong for the reasons given.

items.stem: A workload runs continuously at a predictable level all year. Which pricing approach is most likely to lower cost appropriately?

options.text: Use committed use discounts for the steady baseline
options.rationale: Correct: commitments suit predictable, steady usage.

options.text: Keep everything on-demand regardless of usage
options.rationale: On-demand is costlier for steady baseline load.

options.text: Commit to the peak capacity you ever briefly hit
options.rationale: Committing to peak over-commits for steady load.

options.text: Turn the workload off during business hours
options.rationale: That breaks a workload that must run continuously.

items.explanation: Correct: commitments suit predictable, steady usage.
